mapper.sql: p.id, p.park_no, p.park_name, p.ip_id, p.area_code, p.area_zh, p.address, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.open_time, p.cover_image, p.description, p.status, p.is_hot, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.create_time, p.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM shop_trendy_park p
p.is_deleted = 0
AND p.ip_id = #{q.ipId}
AND p.status = #{q.status}
AND (p.park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.park_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.status DESC, p.id DESC
